=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1884-1891 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Capping RUNNER_LOST_EXAMINED_RUNS at MAX_RUNS can make RUNNER_LOST_RUN_COUNT equal the examined count, so the report is skipped with runner_lost while a run was never examined.
  WHY: Reviewers rated this MAJOR, which is mapped to high. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputed it and found it not reproducible, because only the first MAX_RUNS refs can ever be evidence and failures to read those runs lower the lost count below MAX_RUNS. The cap defeats the fail-open-towards-filing contract when binding drops a ref beyond MAX_RUNS.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:test_intake_reports_when_another_run_was_not_examined | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new regression test uses only 2 run_refs with the default MAX_RUNS of 3, so it never exercises the MAX_RUNS cap.
  WHY: A future run with MAX_RUNS=2 and three refs would hit the false-positive skip without CI catching it. The source rated this NIT, which is mapped to low.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: PR description: "When no other evidence remains, it skips the report with `WORKFLOW_HEAL skip reason=runner_lost`", and the intake comment: "A run dropped for any other reason (unverified, jobs unreadable) keeps the report on the normal path (fail-open towards filing)."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh, the RUNNER_LOST_EXAMINED_RUNS gate (lines 1874-1896)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The gate honors the fail-open contract only while RUN_COUNT + RUNNER_LOST_BIND_DROPPED stays within MAX_RUNS, and both clamps at lines 1888 and 1890 remove the fail-open signal beyond that, and no test in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py covers a report claiming more runs than MAX_RUNS.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

(No findings reported.)

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1888-1891 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The runner-lost skip logic incorrectly suppresses reports when the number of processed runs is capped at MAX_RUNS.
  WHY: If the loop processes MAX_RUNS runs and all are classified as runner-lost, RUNNER_LOST_RUN_COUNT -eq RUNNER_LOST_EXAMINED_RUNS is true (assuming no binding drops), so the intake skips the whole report even if unexamined runs contain real failures.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1882-1890 (especially line 1890) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: RUNNER_LOST_EXAMINED_RUNS is capped at MAX_RUNS after adding RUNNER_LOST_BIND_DROPPED, but bind_report_claims iterates over all payload run_refs while the binding loop fetches jobs for only the first MAX_RUNS.
  WHY: Refs beyond MAX_RUNS are dropped as run_not_in_source_repo (workflow_failure_heal.py:3517), so the cap at line 1890 masks the excess. With MAX_RUNS=2, three refs and the first two lost, line 1891 sees 2==2 and skips, so the real failure of run 502 is never filed.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:test_intake_reports_when_another_run_was_not_examined (bind_dropped and loop_rejected cases) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new regression test never exercises the cap at MAX_RUNS, because the payload has only 2 run_refs and the default WORKFLOW_HEAL_MAX_RUNS is 3.
  WHY: The cap defect has no regression test, so CI would not catch a MAX_RUNS=2 case with three refs.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1884-1891 (binding loop at 708-717) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The skip gate can count a never-examined run as a binding drop, then clamp it away and treat the remaining runs as fully examined.
  WHY: With WORKFLOW_HEAL_MAX_RUNS=2 and three refs, the third is dropped as run_not_in_source_repo, and the total is clamped to 2. If the first two are runner-lost with no summaries, the equality check skips the report even though the third run was never examined.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1886-1890 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Capping RUNNER_LOST_EXAMINED_RUNS at MAX_RUNS makes the skip gate pass when a report claims more runs than the intake inspects, so the report is wrongly skipped with WORKFLOW_HEAL skip reason=runner_lost.
  WHY: With MAX_RUNS=3 and four claimed runs, either all four bind and RUN_COUNT reaches 4, or a 4th is dropped at binding (workflow_failure_heal.py:3515-3517). In both cases the clamp forces the examined count to 3, equal to the lost count, and the unexamined run's failure is never filed.
- TASK_GAP: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh (RUNNER_LOST_EXAMINED_RUNS gate, lines 1874-1896) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: PR description: "When no other evidence remains, it skips the report with `WORKFLOW_HEAL skip reason=runner_lost`", and the intake comment: "A run dropped for any other reason (unverified, jobs unreadable) keeps the report on the normal path (fail-open towards filing)."
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh, the RUNNER_LOST_EXAMINED_RUNS gate (lines 1874-1896)
  Evidence of absence: Both clamps at lines 1888 and 1890 remove the fail-open signal in the >MAX_RUNS cases, and no test covers a report claiming more than MAX_RUNS runs, since the new bind_dropped/loop_rejected cases use exactly 2 refs.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
